messages:
mika: Postmortem INC-4321 is published. Need quick decision: status page text, customer email template, and who gets full RCA. We also need remediation owners in the action tracker.

sam: I can draft customer emails for impacted accounts. Want to hold until rollback is confirmed. ETA draft by EOD.

lina: I'll do the status page blurb and a short FAQ entry. Will keep it 2 lines and link to the PM. Planning to publish within 90 min after sign-off.

maria: Legal: full RCA with mitigation details requires review for regulated customers (72h). Public summary with timeline+impact is fine immediately.

support-bot: SUP-1156 created for impacted customer list. Assigned to @sam. Please update by EOD.

ops-bot: Rollback job depl-982 running: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-service --to-revision=203`. Logs -> /var/log/deploys/depl-982.log

sam: holding customer sends until ops-bot confirms. Once rollback ok i'll send tiered summaries: quick note for all impacted, detailed reviewed report for regulated accounts.

mika: Proposed split: status page (owner: lina) within 2h, customer summary (owner: sam/support) same business day, full RCA to NDA/reg customers after legal review (owner: maria) within 72h. Remediation tasks tracked in PM+JIRA (owner: jess). Agree?

lina: agree. Draft status: `Reduced API availability ~45m on 2026-03-23 UTC due to a retry/backoff regression; mitigation applied and permanent fix in progress. Postmortem: https://redwood.example.com/postmortems/INC-4321`

maria: Add line for regulated customers to request an audited technical report.

sam: will prepare templates and link to SUP-1156.

ops-bot: Rollback succeeded. Verification metrics pending.

mika: Great — sam, please send customer summaries after you attach verification metrics. Lina, publish status page now. Maria, i'll ping you when drafts include mitigation details. Update SUP-1156 and PM-789 with owners/times.

sam: will do. thanks.
